metadata.case_name: TAMANG UDAS v. GLOBAL SUNNY ENGINEERING LIMITED AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Large broad-based posterior disc extrusion at L4/5 level (L4/5 prolapsed intervertebral disc)
source: "MRI of the plaintiff’s lumbar spine showed desiccated L4/5 and L5/S1 discs with large broad-based posterior disc extrusion L4/5 level and small central posterior disc bulge and posterior annulus tear at L5/S1 level."
"Medical Assessment Board (MAB) has been done on 18 July 2011 and assessment on loss of earning capacity permanently caused by the back injury resulting in L4/5 prolapsed intervertebral disc was 6%."

injuries.description: Desiccated discs / degenerative spinal condition affecting L4/5 and L5/S1
source: "MRI of the plaintiff’s lumbar spine showed desiccated L4/5 and L5/S1 discs"
"Dr Wong considered that the discs desiccation was likely to be degenerative in nature."
"Dr Lau is of the view that the desiccated discs are an indication of pre-existing degeneration of the discs"

injuries.description: Soft tissue injury to lower back
source: "The two orthopaedic experts agreed in the Joint Medical Report dated 9 December 2011 that the nature and extent of the injury to the plaintiff was consistent with the history and the mechanism of the accident. The plaintiff suffered mainly soft tissue injury to his lower back."

"They agreed that his injury was appropriately treated by conservative means and had been adequately rehabilitated by the physiotherapists and occupational therapists. They believed that he had reached the state of Maximal Medical Improvement."
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: pain radiated to left buttock and left thigh
numbness over left leg and foot
mild decrease of power over left lower limb
decreased sensation at dorsum of left foot
diminished sensation over Left L3 to L5 dermatome
could not squat / inability to squat
walked with walking stick when walking for longer time
constant back pain (judge found not as severe as pleaded)

losses.description: persistent pain and reduced function of lumbar spine; inability to lift heavy objects; reduced lumbar lordosis and mild marginal osteophyte at L5 vertebra
reduced mobility; increased pain after walking 20-30 minutes; need to use walking stick for longer walks

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: less chance to have sports including soccer and volleyball due to decreased mobility
numbness over left leg and foot and diminished sensation over L3 to L5 dermatome
